items.title: Deploy Blazor Server applications on Amazon ECS with AWS Fargate
items.summary: When modernizing legacy ASP.NET Web Forms applications with tools such as AWS Transform, Blazor Server is often recommended as the target framework. With Blazor, you gain a familiar component-based programming model – but you also inherit a deployment challenge. Blazor Server maintains a persistent WebSocket connection and an in-memory circuit for each browser session, which […]
